title: Conditional Asset Pricing Transformer
abstract: arXiv:2611.19783v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: In this paper, we propose a conditional asset pricing transformer (CAP-T) that captures nonlinear interactions among firms through attention to forecast excess returns. In the first stage, a transformer estimates conditional expected returns, and kernel-weighted principal component analysis of its residuals estimates the local factor loading space. Projecting the conditional mean onto this space separates factor risk compensation from conditional mispricing. Then, in the second stage, separate transformers learn these two components, whose predictions are combined to forecast returns. As a result, the proposed framework decomposes returns into conditional mispricing, factor risk compensation, a centered factor component, and an unpredictable innovation. translated_abstract: 在本文中，我们提出了一种条件资产定价Transformer（CAP-T），它通过注意力机制捕捉企业之间的非线性交互作用，以预测超额收益。在第一阶段，一个Transformer估计条件期望收益，并对其残差进行核加权主成分分析以估计局部因子载荷空间。将条件均值投影到该空间上，可以将因子风险补偿与条件错误定价分离开来。随后，在第二阶段，使用独立的Transformer分别学习这两个组成部分，其预测结果相结合用于预测收益。由此，所提出的框架将收益分解为条件错误定价、因子风险补偿、中心化因子成分和不可预测的新息项。我们建立了近似界和泛化界，并刻画了第一阶段的预测误差如何通过局部因子估计和成分学习进行传播，从而提供了统计……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出条件资产定价Transformer（CAP-T），通过两阶段注意力框架将超额收益分解为条件错误定价与因子风险补偿等成分，实现对收益更准确的预测与理论保证。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a Conditional Asset Pricing Transformer (CAP-T) that uses a two-stage attention framework to decompose excess returns into conditional mispricing and factor risk compensation, enabling more accurate return forecasting with theoretical guarantees.
